title: Christmas Character Bow Clipart Bundle
author: Tanya Kart
description:
Christmas Character Bow Clipart Bundle – 16 Cute Holiday Character & Festive Bow PNGs
Add playful holiday charm to your creative projects with this Christmas Character Bow Clipart Bundle, featuring 16 high-resolution PNG designs combining adorable Christmas characters with oversized festive bows.
This cheerful collection includes Santa Claus, Mrs. Claus, snowman, Christmas kitten, mouse, winter yeti, holiday gnome, nutcracker, and other cute seasonal characters, paired with beautiful red, green, gold, and icy blue Christmas bows.
The bright cartoon illustration style, expressive faces, and bold holiday colors make these graphics perfect for fun Christmas crafts, kids’ designs, personalized gifts, and seasonal merchandise.
Perfect for Christmas sublimation, T-shirts, sweatshirts, mugs, tumblers, tote bags, stickers, ornaments, gift tags, greeting cards, invitations, scrapbooking, printable crafts, party decorations, holiday signs, and Christmas merchandise.

300 DPI quality
Individual Christmas character graphics
Festive bow designs
Digital download
Perfect for print and digital creative projects
Ideal for creators searching for Christmas character clipart, Christmas bow PNGs, cute holiday characters, Santa clipart, snowman PNG, Christmas animal clipart, nutcracker graphics, gnome Christmas PNG, and festive sublimation designs.
